{{Quote|Minimal casualties, maximum effectiveness. That's us.|Broadside, on Shadow Squadron|audio=MaxEffectivenesstrim-SoM.flac|<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Decoded">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''|d=y}}</ref>}}
'''Shadow Squadron''' was a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] personally trained and led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], consisting of at least twelve [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighters]]. Its members included [[Matchstick]], [[Broadside/Legends|Broadside]], and [[Tag (clone trooper pilot)/Legends|Tag]].

==History==
[[File:Shadow_Squadron_briefing.png|thumb|left|200px|The pilots of shadow squadron being briefed on a [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|battle]]]]
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] personally trained Shadow Squadron.<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence Decoded" /> Originally, Shadow Squadron flew [[V-19 Torrent starfighter/Legends|V-19 Torrent starfighters]]. They played a major role in the [[Battle of Kadavo/Legends|attack]] on, and subsequent liberation of, the [[Kadavo slave processing facility/Legends|slave processing facility]] on [[Kadavo/Legends|Kadavo]].<ref name="Slaves of the Republic 6>[[The Clone Wars 6|''The Clone Wars'' 6]]</ref> After this, Shadow Squadron implemented the [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wing starfighters]] that Skywalker obtained.<ref name="Procedure">''[[The Clone Wars: Procedure]]''</ref>

Shadow Squadron participated in the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|attack]] on [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']], taking heavy casualties. During the battle, Skywalker served temporarily as Shadow Leader. He was joined in his Y-wing by his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who served as their [[Astromech droid/Legends|navigational droid]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] assisted as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fighter escort in [[Blade of Dorin/Legends|his]] [[Delta-7B Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7B interceptor]].<ref name="Shadow of Malevolence">{{TCW|Shadow of Malevolence|Shadow of ''Malevolence''}}</ref>
